Lemon Chicken
By: Kara Bagley
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




5 teaspoons lemon juice , fresh
3 teaspoons soy sauce
2 garlic cloves , minced
1/8 teaspoon pepper
1 teaspoon basil
4 boneless skinless chicken breasts

Preparation

1 Pound chicken breasts to 1/4 thick. 2 In a mixing bowl, add all the ingredients and marinate the chicken for at least 2 hours. 3 GRILL.
